traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Structure meets dream. Grounding imagination into reality, or pessimism colliding with illusion. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Expecting the worst, anxiety, and worry that mostly never materializes. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Limit and imagination reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
shadow: Fear and rigidity collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: A generous promise can look different once the budget, policy, or deadline shows who will actually be left without what was promised.

readerCopy.body: A generous promise can look different once the budget, policy, or deadline shows who will actually be left without what was promised. When Saturn opposes Neptune, ideals and practical limits face each other directly, exposing the distance between what people want to provide and what a structure can support. Good intentions do not pay the bill or make an inaccessible system usable. The promise is easier to judge by what actually reaches the people it was meant to help.
